section.title: pharm_hist
section.p: Pharmaceutical Historian is an international journal for the history of pharmacy published by the British Society for the History of Pharmacy on behalf of the International Society for the History of Pharmacy. The first number appeared in 1967 (ISSN 0079-1393, Print), and it is now an open access peer reviewed journal. It publishes original articles on the history of pharmacy and related fields from across the world and across all time periods.

Articles from 2017 up to the present can be found
here
. Retrodigitized issues (1967-2020) can be found
here
.

Full instructions for contributors are given
here
. Contributions and attachments should be sent to editor@bshp.org or Stuart.Anderson@lshtm.ac.uk.

Authors should have their contributions reviewed by a native English speaker prior to submission, as this service cannot be provided by the journal’s editors. Papers written in poor English will be returned for revisions to be made. Papers should be submitted using British English spelling; the appropriate language preference setting should be selected.
